lines.en: Spread wings and glide forward

lines.zh: 用龙爪在地上划出痕迹
lines.en: Scrape claws on the ground

lines.zh: 尾部扫过地面激起尘土
lines.en: Swish tail to stir up dust
Rumble shakes the ground

lines.zh: 口中喷出火焰照亮道路
lines.en: Breath fire to light the way

lines.zh: 地面留下深浅不一的爪痕
lines.en: Claw marks appear on the ground

lines.zh: 用龙牙轻触地面寻找食物
lines.en: Taste the ground with fangs

lines.zh: 从口中发出低沉的咆哮声
lines.en: Loud growl from mouth
Move slowly, eyes sharp
Wing flap, speed up
I lower my body so the rider sits steady.
Four claws trade off across the bone waste.
My tail tip scores a trail marker in the dirt.
My great eye sweeps the ground left and right.
Eyes glow with blue light

lines.zh: 背上的鞍还空着，等人骑。
lines.en: The saddle on my back is still empty.
My great eye half closed, teeth showing.
Close eyes, enjoy peace
Tail sways, relax
Eyes scan the surroundings
Masticate quietly
Pace, think
One yawn sends gravel rolling.
I lie down and loosen the saddle strap.
Lids half shut, still watching ahead.
Resting my chin on my forepaw.
A small puff of hot breath from my nostrils.
My back rises and falls, waiting for a rider.
See player, spread wings

lines.zh: 盯着玩家，眼中闪烁蓝光
lines.en: Stare at player, eyes glow

lines.zh: 朝向玩家，喷出蓝色火焰
lines.en: Turn to player, breath blue fire
Point claw at player
Low rumble, threatening
Open mouth, ready to attack
Fly toward player, prepare to land

lines.zh: 警惕地观察玩家的动作
lines.en: Carefully observe player
Approach player, ready to interact
I bring my big eye right up to you.
I lower my head to sniff your boots.
My pupil narrows to a slit.
I nudge your shoulder with my snout.

lines.zh: 抬眼确认你是不是骑手
lines.en: I look up to see if you are my rider.
A low rumble rolls in my throat.
Sss, my scales are hurt!
Ouch! My body got scratched!
Ow! My wings are injured!
Sss, my tail is hurt!
Aaah, my eyes are hurt!
Sss, I got knocked around!
Ouch, my skin is cracked!
Sss, I got cut!
Ouch, my body hurts!
Sss, I got kicked!

lines.zh: 你散发的光芒让我心动！
lines.en: Your light attracts me!
Dance with light!
My eyes hunger for your light!
That light is too bright; I can't look away.
Share this moment of light!

lines.zh: 你手里的亮东西晃到我了。
lines.en: The shiny thing in your hand caught my eye.

lines.zh: 和我一起创造光的传说吧！
lines.en: Create a legend of light with me!
Fly in the light together!

lines.zh: 我的灵魂被你的光吸引！
lines.en: My soul is drawn to your light!

lines.zh: 我愿意成为你的光芒伴侣！
lines.en: I want to be your light companion!
You block my light!
Move! I need space!

lines.zh: 我的光会照亮你的道路！
lines.en: My light will guide your path!
Move out of my way!
Be careful, don't block my view!

lines.zh: 我的光芒可以穿透一切障碍！
lines.en: My light can cut through obstacles!
Clear the way for me!
Don't block my sight!
Move! I need to go!
Move, I need to fly freely!

lines.zh: 地面上也得挑个结实的。
lines.en: Even on the ground, I pick a sturdy one.

lines.zh: 我的伴侣需要智慧和勇气！
lines.en: My mate needs wit and courage!

lines.zh: 只有最勇敢的才能赢得我的心！
lines.en: Only the bravest can win my heart!
I will fight for my mate!

lines.zh: 我的伴侣必须强大如我！
lines.en: My mate must be as strong as me!

lines.zh: 我的伴侣将共享我的光芒！
lines.en: My mate will share my light!
Choosing the right partner is important!
My mate will dance with me!
I wait for your answer on the ground.

lines.zh: 能驮起我的，才配站我身边。
lines.en: Only one who can carry me belongs at my side.

lines.zh: 我用爪子按住这块骨头。
lines.en: I pin this bone under my claw.
This is my ground!
Follow me, I’ll lead the way.
Scrape your skin with my scales.
My snort blows the gravel aside.
Burn with my fire.

lines.zh: 地上这块，我的眼睛先看见。
lines.en: My eye spots it on the ground first.
I rule the ground.
Mount my back, I’ll fly with you.
The ground is our stage.
The saddle strap tightens; I'm charging.

lines.zh: 我闻到肉味了，就在前面。
lines.en: I smell meat, right ahead.
My back is empty. Who climbs on?
With a rider, my charge is steadier.
You’re my next!

lines.zh: 背上坐稳，我这只眼龙跑得快。
lines.en: Sit tight. This eyekin runs fast.
Focus on you.
The ground shakes; that's me running.
Rider on my back, hold tight.
My gaze will kill you.
My great eye goes still.

lines.zh: 地面传来不属于我的脚步
lines.en: Footsteps on the ground are not mine.
My nose finds the heat of something alive.
I hold a breath in my throat.
You back to the cliff; I'm still coming.
My flames will cover you!
My claws tear up the soil.
Receive my judgment!
My scales will protect me.
Don't run; my legs are faster.
Once you're on my back, don't let go.
My gaze will guide you.
My attacks cannot be dodged.
You will taste my power.
I flatten low, ready to lunge.
My eye locks onto its chest.
I close the gap in halting steps.
My tail lifts slowly and drops.
There's a saddle on my back.
The fire in my throat runs hot.
Cracks spread under my pressed claws.
Ride me, and I still breathe fire.
Roar warning!

lines.zh: 我贴地扑过去，翅膀收起来。
lines.en: I hug the ground and pounce, wings folded.
Claw attack!
Spit lava balls!
Flap wings to scare!
Cry sharply!
My great eye blinks as my teeth close.
Open wide!
Tail swipe!
My forepaw slams; the ground sinks.
A low headbutt flips it over.
My fangs clamp onto its armor.
One tail sweep knocks down a row.
Spawn from cracks!
Spawn near lava!
Emerging from rocks!
Drilling up from underground!
Cave appearance!
Roam on ground!
Spawn in lava pools!
Erupt from volcanoes!
Active in hot rock layers!
Lurking on surface!

lines.zh: 从骨荒原的裂缝里爬出
lines.en: Crawling out of a crack in the bone waste.

lines.zh: 血肉平原上睁开一只巨眼
lines.en: A giant eye opens on the flesh plains.

lines.zh: 基岩的洞底传来爬行声
lines.en: Scraping echoes from the hole in bedrock.
I rise slowly out of the dark.
The saddle mark on my back still itches.

lines.zh: 我把地底的空气吸进肺里
lines.en: I draw the deep air into my lungs.

lines.zh: 骨堆塌了，我从里面钻出
lines.en: The bone pile collapses and I crawl out.
My great eye catches daylight for the first time.
I shake the bone dust off my scales.
I come to rest at the flesh plains' edge.

lines.zh: 嘶，我的鳞片受伤了，被火烧的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: Sss, my scales are hurt! — and the fire makes it worse.
Ouch! I got burned by fire!
Ouch! I got injured by water!
Boom! I got injured by an explosion!
Snap! I got hit by a projectile!
Sss! I got hit by magic!
Ouch! I'm starving!
Ouch! I got struck by lightning!
Sss! I fell into the void!
